Minutes of the Meeting of the District Level Reservation Committee in presence of
representatives of recognized political parties held on 26th December 2024 at 2:30 PM in
the Conference Hall of District Commissioner, Charaideo for Reservation of PRI
Constituencies for SCs/ STs/ Women inview of Panchayat Election-2025.
         The Meeting was chaired by Dr. Neha Jadav, IAS, District Commissioner of Charaideo
District. The Chaiman welcomed all the members present the meeting and initiated the discussion
by apprising the members that the meeting has been convened for finalizing the Reservation of
Constituencies for Schedule Caste, Scheduled Tribes & Women for the upcoming Panchayat Election
2025 as per relevant acts and rules.
    1. The list of members present is enclosed at Annexure-1
    2. The Member Secretary of the District Level Reservation Committee, Sri Navadeep
       Changmai, ACS, Additional District Commissioner, Charaideo explained the purpose of the
          meeting and explained the guidelines / sOP issued by Panchayat and Rural Development,
           Gov, of Assamvide No. E-589887/1/850242/2024 Dt. 10/12/2024.
                  Thereafter, Sri Deepak Bhuyan, ACS, Chief Executive Officer, Zilla Parishad briefly
          explained the related provisions of the Assam Panchayat Act, 1994 (as amended) and The
          Assam Panchayat Rules 1995 (as amended) &Rules 2023 ete. to all the members presented in
          the meeting.
   3. The important points of the guidelines which were followed during the process of reservation
      were highlighted in the meeting as follows:
         a) The Census Report of 2001 was taken for working out population, viz; total
            population, Schedules Castes population and Scheduled Tribes population in different
            levels of PRIConstituencies.
      b) Reservation of seats of Ward Members /President Vice-President of the Gaon
            Panchayats, Members President /Vice-President of the Anchalik Panchayats and
            Members of the Zilla Parishads for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribes and Women
            shallbe done at the district-level by the District Commissioners.
      c) Reservation of seats of President /Vice-President of the Zilla Parishads for Scheduled
         Caste, Scheduled Tribes and Women shall be done by the State Government.
         (Panchayat & Rural Development Department).
      d) Among the wards of Gaon Panchayats having more than 10% of the Scheduled Castes
         or Scheduled Tribes population shall be selected for purpose of reserving seats for
        Schedule Castes and Schedule Tribes by rotation as per sub-section (5) of Section 9 of
        Assam Panchayat (Amendment) Act, 2023.
